title: Jensen Huang unveils $1.16B package to back 5 UK startups
source_used: Tech.eu (15 Oct 2026), TokenPost, Tech Funding News; NewsBytes headline seen
key_facts: Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang announced at a London event on the evening of 14 Oct 2026 that Nvidia is planning new investments in five UK startups.
They are Boltz (AI drug discovery), Foresight (infrastructure predictor), Hiverge (AI logistics planning), Prima Mente (AI biology) and Riverlane (quantum computing).
Nvidia is understood to be taking a minority stake in each of the five.
TokenPost: the amount, stake size and closing date of each deal were not specified.
Nvidia's existing UK investments include Basecamp Research, Ineffable Intelligence, Synthesia and Wayve.
It follows Nvidia's announcement of investments in four French startups (Doctolib, Entalpic, Genesis AI, Pigment) and a $250 million compute donation for UK AI safety research.
NewsBytes' headline says $1.16 billion package; none of the readable reports gives that figure.
quote_evidence: Nvidia is planning new investments in five UK startups, its boss said last night, as it continues to spread its reach across the startup ecosystem.
Nvidia is understood to be taking a minority stake in the five startups.

Nvidia plans investments in five U.K. startups spanning biological AI, infrastructure planning and quantum computing, extending its European startup push while leaving each deal's amount, stake size and closing date unspecified.
why_it_matters_hint: Nvidia adds five UK AI and quantum startups to its investment portfolio, amounts undisclosed.
event_date: 14 Oct 2026 (Tech.eu: 'last night' in an article of 15 Oct; TokenPost says 13 Oct)
